title: SQL injection in region_for() via string interpolation of project parameter
detail: src/aurora/aurora-portal/aurora_portal/region_lookup.py:L10-11 passes a format-string SQL query to cursor.execute() where the project parameter is substituted with '%s'; the TABLE portion is a module constant and is safe, but the project value is caller-supplied and allows SQL injection via the unquoted context. Upgraded to high because project is an external parameter with an injectable quoting context.
